findings.message: Approve exactly one read/edit/write-only Luna authoring launch27 under the inspected launch_027 contract. It addresses the three review26 lifecycle findings, restores the accidental stdin payload change and explicitly retains the saved-duration safety improvement. Only tests/e2e/test_review_adapter_e2e.py may change. The six unrelated findings remain open.

The card requires non-raising cooperative SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers across child acquisition and finalization, guarded partial handler restoration, a no-signal phase before every reap, independent bounded cleanup obligations, single guarded finalization, and truthful resource/receipt outcomes. It adds only one fixed cleanup-interrupt public scenario, retains the fixed bounds and actual sandbox/adapter path, and does not expand arbitrary command or execution controls. These are suitable authoring requirements; implementation safety remains unproved until source re-review.

Computed all six launch_027 input hashes and found them equal to the card. Current candidate test SHA256 e27c301dbcffa733ce5aa6f95207399ee0f4eb717f76f4b68a5799addc81ed43 matches frozen26 and candidate-transition-026.json. Root reports full-manifest verification and sole-path transition. Launcher, guardian and profile hashes still match the prior independent dispatch review.

Coding26 guardian receipt reports worker reaped, exit zero, reason null and credential removal. private-pi is currently empty and ledger records 26/36. Root reports unchanged provider/binaries/configuration since the successful fresh smoke and no candidate execution. This review does not request another smoke.

Frozen26 remains IMPLEMENTED_UNACCEPTED, safe_for_execution=false and ownership_card_closed=false. Using it as the correction base does not accept it. Neither plan27's later templates nor any runtime probe, matrix, import, rejected controller or unattended workflow is approved.

conditions: Dispatch only the reviewed launch_027 section with non-expanding operational instructions. Reserve exactly slot27 from ledger26 using a fresh unique job/workspace. No automatic later launch.

Retain exclusive S workflow ownership, no concurrent runtime writer, verified unchanged dispatch controls, absent old worker and temporary credential, and current candidate equality with the full frozen26 manifest. Prior dispatch-review control conditions continue to apply.

Use reconciled D10 allocation and current elapsed active work rather than the plan's approximate checkpoint; enforce 36 coding launches and 32400 active seconds and the launcher's 660-second remaining reserve. Preserve same-objective attempt accounting and fresh-replan gates.

Worker actions remain source authoring only, with read/edit/write tools and the existing nofork sandbox. Root verifies external input hashes; listed outside-sandbox paths do not authorize expanded worker filesystem access. No candidate execution, tests, helper imports, subprocess tools, Docker, Claude or provider invocation by the worker.

After launch, independently validate full provider completion, tool activity, single-file scope, immutable parent/candidate bindings, frozen manifests, worker reaping and credential absence. Keep resulting source UNACCEPTED for an independent Astra review of the exact revision.

Any execution requires full applicable source-safety closure and independent outer-wrapper review. Cooperative-signal and fixed-fault requirements are a finite contract, not proof against interpreter crashes, SIGKILL or arbitrary asynchronous failures. Do not infer runtime success from source review or lifecycle receipt literals.
